name: Differentiable Ellipsoid Primitive
definition: A primitive representation using constant-density ellipsoidal shapes, replacing the long-tailed Gaussian to reduce spatial overlap and memory usage.
summary: The Differentiable Ellipsoid Primitive is a sigmoid-based geometric representation that replaces long-tailed Gaussians with constant-density ellipsoids to reduce memory usage while ensuring full differentiability for stable volumetric training.
